mentions.name: Keel
mentions.description: A productivity app that combines todo lists, pomodoro timers, and an AI executive coach to guide users through a full plan > execute > reflect cycle. The AI agent (text or voice) helps with planning and guides reflection but does not do the work for the user. An Android app is in beta and an iOS app is in development.
mentions.source_excerpt: Keel is a productivity app that combines todo lists, pomodoro, and an AI executive coach to let users go through a whole plan > execute > reflect cycle in the app.
mentions.author: thecolorblue
